# Johnny Lim

> Johnny Lim is a Singapore-based digital marketing manager specialising in SEO and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO). He has six years of hands-on SEO, content and website marketing experience and is currently Senior Marketing Manager at Kepler Search, a specialist recruitment firm for the commodities and trading sector.

## Key facts
- Location: Singapore
- Focus: SEO, Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), AI search visibility (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity), authority content and original research
- Results: took Kepler Search's website to #1 on Google in Singapore for "best executive search firm Singapore" within about six weeks, with the firm cited in Google AI Overviews and ChatGPT; around 30 inbound client enquiries in six months from prospects who found the firm through AI search; led the Singapore Commodities Talent Survey 2026 (Kepler Search); grew website visits from 1–2 a month to around 1,000 a month in 12 months, and webinar attendance by 300% (Include Consulting)
- Industry experience includes recruitment, engineering, consulting, proptech and event technology; approach applies across B2B sectors
- Education: Master of International Business and Bachelor of Advertising, Marketing & PR, Queensland University of Technology

## Case studies
- [Case studies](https://johnnylimsg.github.io/case-studies/): Detailed SEO and GEO case studies with situation, approach, results and lessons
- [From paid search to #1 on Google and cited by AI: a Singapore executive search firm](https://johnnylimsg.github.io/case-studies/executive-search-firm-seo-geo/): Almost no SEO and ~6 visitors a month from paid search, to #1 on Google in about six weeks, AI Overview and ChatGPT citations about two months later, and ~30 enquiries in six months that all became clients

- [From almost no visitors to around 1,000 a month: content strategy for a B2B consulting firm](https://johnnylimsg.github.io/case-studies/b2b-consulting-content-strategy/): Website not found on Google with 1–2 visits a month, to around 1,000 a month in 12 months through technical SEO, consultant-informed content (two articles a month, quarterly reports, webinars) and a HubSpot newsletter; enquiries, webinar sign-ups and new clients

## Blog
- [SEO vs GEO vs AEO vs AIO: what's the difference, and which matters?](https://johnnylimsg.github.io/blog/seo-vs-geo-vs-aeo-vs-aio/): A plain-English comparison of SEO, GEO, AEO and AIO from a Singapore marketer who has ranked #1 on Google and been cited in AI answers: what each means, how they overlap, and where to start.
- [SEO for recruitment firms: stop publishing generic content](https://johnnylimsg.github.io/blog/seo-for-recruitment-firms/): What I've learned doing SEO for a specialist recruiter: why generic content gets ignored by Google and AI search, and what works instead.
- [SEO vs GEO: what changes when search gives answers instead of links](https://johnnylimsg.github.io/blog/seo-vs-geo/): Generative Engine Optimisation builds on SEO rather than replacing it. Here's what stays the same, what changes, and a practical checklist for getting cited by AI answer engines.
